name: AICTE-National Initiative for Training of Technical Teachers (for Inductee Teachers) Scheme
benefit: - **Training:** Inductee Teachers will get training in three phases.- **Certification:** Only after successful completion of all the three phases, a final training completion certificate shall be issued to the Inductee Teacher.
_eligibility_text: 1. All the teachers working in technical institutions/universities imparting technical education [(as defined in Section 2(h) of AICTE Act 1987).](https://www.aicte-india.org/downloads/aicteact.pdf)1. Programmes should be recognised by AICTE.
